_comment: CIS Ubuntu 22.04 test hardening profile — 10 rules for the cis-ubuntu-target container. Each rule entry is matched to its policy rule_id when the seed script runs.

rules.title: Ensure /tmp is configured on a separate partition
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('findmnt -n /tmp 2>/dev/null')
line = out.output.strip()
has_nodev  = 'nodev'  in line
has_nosuid = 'nosuid' in line
has_noexec = 'noexec' in line
result['compliant'] = has_nodev and has_nosuid and has_noexec
result['details'] = ('findmnt output: \"' + line + '\". ' +
    'nodev=' + str(has_nodev) +
    ', nosuid=' + str(has_nosuid) +
    ', noexec=' + str(has_noexec))
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('findmnt -n /tmp 2>/dev/null')
result['saved_state'] = {'previous_tmp_options': cur.output.strip()}
r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_1_tmp_options rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime')
result['success'] = r.success
result['details'] = 'Set /tmp mount options to rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime in simulation state. ' + r.output
rules.rollback_code:
prev = saved_state.get('previous_tmp_options', '')
if prev:
    r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_1_tmp_options ' + prev)
else:
    r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_1_tmp_options empty')
    connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_1_tmp_options ')
result['success'] = True
result['details'] = 'Restored /tmp mount options to: \"' + str(prev) + '\"'

rules.title: Ensure AIDE is installed and configured
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('dpkg -s aide 2>/dev/null | grep -i Status')
result['compliant'] = 'install ok installed' in out.output.lower()
result['details'] = 'AIDE dpkg status: \"' + out.output.strip() + '\"'
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('dpkg -s aide 2>/dev/null | grep -i Status')
was_installed = 'install ok installed' in cur.output.lower()
result['saved_state'] = {'previously_installed': was_installed}
r1 = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_2_aide_installed true')
r2 = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_2_aide_cron true')
result['success'] = r1.success
result['details'] = 'Simulated AIDE installation and cron schedule. ' + r1.output
rules.rollback_code:
was_installed = saved_state.get('previously_installed', False)
val = 'true' if was_installed else 'false'
connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_2_aide_installed ' + val)
connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_2_aide_cron false')
result['success'] = True
result['details'] = 'Rolled back AIDE installation state to: installed=' + str(was_installed)

rules.title: Ensure permissions on bootloader config are restricted (GRUB)
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('stat -c "%a %U %G" /boot/grub/grub.cfg 2>/dev/null')
vals = out.output.strip().split()
if len(vals) == 3:
    perms, owner, group = vals
    perms_int = int(perms, 8)
    result['compliant'] = (not (perms_int & 0o177)) and owner == 'root' and group == 'root'
    result['details'] = 'Permissions: ' + perms + ', Owner: ' + owner + ', Group: ' + group + '. Expected: 0400 root:root'
else:
    result['compliant'] = False
    result['details'] = 'Could not stat /boot/grub/grub.cfg: ' + out.output
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('stat -c "%a %U %G" /boot/grub/grub.cfg 2>/dev/null')
vals = cur.output.strip().split()
result['saved_state'] = {
    'previous_perms': vals[0] if vals else '755',
    'previous_owner': vals[1] if len(vals) > 1 else 'root',
    'previous_group': vals[2] if len(vals) > 2 else 'root'
}
r1 = connector.run_command('sudo chown root:root /boot/grub/grub.cfg')
r2 = connector.run_command('sudo chmod og-rwx /boot/grub/grub.cfg')
result['success'] = r2.success
result['details'] = 'Set /boot/grub/grub.cfg to root:root og-rwx. chown_ok=' + str(r1.success) + ', chmod_ok=' + str(r2.success)
rules.rollback_code:
prev_perms = saved_state.get('previous_perms', '755')
prev_owner = saved_state.get('previous_owner', 'root')
prev_group = saved_state.get('previous_group', 'root')
r1 = connector.run_command('sudo chown ' + prev_owner + ':' + prev_group + ' /boot/grub/grub.cfg')
r2 = connector.run_command('sudo chmod ' + prev_perms + ' /boot/grub/grub.cfg')
result['success'] = r2.success
result['details'] = 'Restored /boot/grub/grub.cfg to ' + prev_perms + ' ' + prev_owner + ':' + prev_group

result['compliant'] = 'protocol 2' in out.output.lower()

result['success'] = r.success

rules.rollback_code:

rules.title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -i permitrootlogin')
result['compliant'] = 'permitrootlogin no' in out.output.lower()
result['details'] = 'SSH permitrootlogin line: \"' + out.output.strip() + '\"'
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -i permitrootlogin')
prev_val = 'no' if 'permitrootlogin no' in cur.output.lower() else 'yes'
result['saved_state'] = {'previous_root_login': prev_val}
r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_6_ssh_root_login no')
result['success'] = r.success
result['details'] = 'Set SSH PermitRootLogin to no. ' + r.output
rules.rollback_code:
prev_val = saved_state.get('previous_root_login', 'yes')
r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_6_ssh_root_login ' + str(prev_val))
result['success'] = r.success
result['details'] = 'Restored SSH PermitRootLogin to: ' + str(prev_val)

rules.title: Ensure password hashing algorithm is SHA-512
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('grep pam_unix /etc/pam.d/common-password 2>/dev/null')
result['compliant'] = 'sha512' in out.output.lower()
result['details'] = 'pam_unix line in common-password: \"' + out.output.strip() + '\"'
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('grep pam_unix /etc/pam.d/common-password 2>/dev/null')
has_sha512 = 'sha512' in cur.output.lower()
has_md5    = 'md5'    in cur.output.lower()
prev_hash = 'sha512' if has_sha512 else ('md5' if has_md5 else 'md5')
result['saved_state'] = {'previous_hash': prev_hash}
r = connector.run_command('sudo sed -i "s/obscure md5/obscure sha512/" /etc/pam.d/common-password')
result['success'] = r.success
verify = connector.run_command('grep pam_unix /etc/pam.d/common-password 2>/dev/null')
result['details'] = 'Updated PAM to SHA-512. Current line: \"' + verify.output.strip() + '\"'
rules.rollback_code:
prev_hash = saved_state.get('previous_hash', 'md5')
r = connector.run_command('sudo sed -i "s/obscure sha512/obscure ' + prev_hash + '/" /etc/pam.d/common-password')
result['success'] = r.success
verify = connector.run_command('grep pam_unix /etc/pam.d/common-password 2>/dev/null')
result['details'] = 'Rolled back PAM hash to ' + prev_hash + '. Current: \"' + verify.output.strip() + '\"'

rules.title: Ensure /etc/passwd file permissions are configured
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('stat -c "%a %U %G" /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null')
vals = out.output.strip().split()
if len(vals) == 3:
    perms, owner, group = vals
    result['compliant'] = (perms == '644') and (owner == 'root') and (group == 'root')
    result['details'] = 'Permissions: ' + perms + ', Owner: ' + owner + ', Group: ' + group + '. Expected: 644 root:root'
else:
    result['compliant'] = False
    result['details'] = 'Could not stat /etc/passwd: ' + out.output
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('stat -c "%a %U %G" /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null')
vals = cur.output.strip().split()
result['saved_state'] = {
    'previous_perms': vals[0] if vals else '664',
    'previous_owner': vals[1] if len(vals) > 1 else 'root',
    'previous_group': vals[2] if len(vals) > 2 else 'root'
}
r1 = connector.run_command('sudo chown root:root /etc/passwd')
r2 = connector.run_command('sudo chmod 644 /etc/passwd')
result['success'] = r2.success
result['details'] = 'Set /etc/passwd to 644 root:root. chown_ok=' + str(r1.success) + ', chmod_ok=' + str(r2.success)
rules.rollback_code:
prev_perms = saved_state.get('previous_perms', '664')
prev_owner = saved_state.get('previous_owner', 'root')
prev_group = saved_state.get('previous_group', 'root')
r1 = connector.run_command('sudo chown ' + prev_owner + ':' + prev_group + ' /etc/passwd')
r2 = connector.run_command('sudo chmod ' + prev_perms + ' /etc/passwd')
result['success'] = r2.success
result['details'] = 'Restored /etc/passwd to ' + prev_perms + ' ' + prev_owner + ':' + prev_group

rules.title: Ensure AppArmor is enabled and enforcing profiles
rules.evaluation_code:
out = connector.run_command('apparmor_status 2>/dev/null | grep "profiles are in enforce mode"')
parts = out.output.strip().split()
count = int(parts[0]) if parts and parts[0].isdigit() else 0
result['compliant'] = count > 0
result['details'] = 'AppArmor enforcing profiles: ' + str(count) + '. Line: \"' + out.output.strip() + '\"'
rules.remediation_code:
cur = connector.run_command('apparmor_status 2>/dev/null | grep "profiles are in enforce mode"')
parts = cur.output.strip().split()
prev_count = int(parts[0]) if parts and parts[0].isdigit() else 0
result['saved_state'] = {'previous_enforcing_count': prev_count}
r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_10_apparmor_enforcing 5')
result['success'] = r.success
result['details'] = 'Simulated AppArmor with 5 enforcing profiles. ' + r.output
rules.rollback_code:
prev_count = saved_state.get('previous_enforcing_count', 0)
r = connector.run_command('python3 /aegis-scripts/aegis-state.py set rule_10_apparmor_enforcing ' + str(prev_count))
result['success'] = r.success
result['details'] = 'Restored AppArmor enforcing count to: ' + str(prev_count)
